name: goal-driven
description: LLM-evaluated goal completion loop. A coder implements towards the goal, and an LLM evaluator judges whether the goal has been achieved after each iteration. Stops when the evaluator determines the goal is met or the iteration limit is reached.

parameters.name: max_iterations
parameters.description: Maximum number of iterations before the loop stops regardless of goal completion

parameters.name: goal_evaluation_prompt
parameters.description: Custom evaluation criteria the LLM uses to judge goal achievement
parameters.default: Evaluate whether the implementation fully satisfies the stated goal. Consider correctness, completeness, and whether all requirements have been addressed. Only mark as achieved if the work is production-ready.

roles.name: plan
roles.prompt: Analyze the goal and create a clear implementation plan. If this is a continuation iteration, review the previous work output and refine the plan to address remaining gaps.

roles.name: implement
roles.prompt: Implement the plan from the previous stage. Follow the plan's steps precisely. Write clean, tested code directly to the filesystem using the project directory. If continuing from a previous iteration, focus on completing the remaining work identified in the plan. After implementation, run verification commands and summarize what was done and any remaining gaps.
